name: carvo-import-engine
title: Moteur d'import CARVO
description: Plugin MCP. The import engine stays independent (import 1688, measurements, D-034). When plugged into Seller ERP it can arrange products and read real leaf attributes. It does not publish, start a platform crawl, or expose Daigou secrets.

tools.name: import_placement
tools.description: ai_place policy: two voices, min_confidence 0.8, otherwise keep_review. invents_leaf is false.

tools.name: read_measurements
tools.description: Read real leaf attribute groups from leaf-attrs.json (supplier_template captures). Does not invent values or fill the size guide.

tools.name: arrange_product
tools.description: Drive Seller ERP Ajouter: open the suggested leaf at or above 0.8 and continue to details.

tools.name: import_status
tools.description: Read-only: import remains on the independent engine (D-034). Does not start an import.
